_comment: UML 2.5. Edit uml.md to change the agent's guidance.
name: uml
title: UML 2.5
description: Class, component, deployment, use case, activity and state machine diagrams.

association.description: Structural link between classifiers; put role names/multiplicities in the label, e.g. '1..* orders'.

directed_association.description: Navigable association from source to target.

aggregation.description: Shared aggregation: source is the whole, target the part (hollow diamond at the source).

composition.description: Composite aggregation: source is the whole and owns the lifecycle of target (filled diamond at the source).

dependency.description: Source depends on target. Optional stereotype in the label, e.g. «use», «create».

include.description: Base use case (source) always includes the target use case.

extend.description: Extending use case (source) optionally extends the base use case (target).

communication.description: Actor participates in a use case (plain line).

control_flow.description: Activity control flow from source to target; guards go in the label as [condition].

transition.description: State machine transition; label as 'trigger [guard] / effect'.

note_link.description: Attaches a note (source) to an element (target).
